claims.claim: A second coffin on the western waterfall edge near The Nameless Eternal City sends the player to Ainsel River Main; it is separate from the coffin used to enter Deeproot from Siofra Aqueduct.

notes: The coffin transition is modeled as one-way because the sources describe the Deeproot-to-Ainsel arrival, not a reverse walkable route.
No article text, images, tiles or original game coordinates are copied.
